sources.snippet: duced from Bielik-11B-v3-Base by structured pruning (11.04B to 7.35B parameters, NVIDIA Minitron-style [18]) followed by logit distillation from the parent, and it shares the par-ent’s architecture family, training corpus, and tokenizer [17]. Q8_0, Q6_K, Q5_K_M, and Q4_K_M were obtained directly from the publisher’s official GGUF release; because that release stops at Q4_K_M and no public half-precision GGUF exists, Q3_K_M and Q2_K were requantized from Q8_0 via llama-quantize --allow-requantize.
